About Multidex

Multidex is an unofficial Pokédex and reference app for Android and the web, published on Google Play by Kudos Labs and operated by Kunal Das. By using Multidex, you agree to these terms.

Pokémon and Pokémon character names are trademarks of Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc. and The Pokémon Company. Multidex is a fan-made app and is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by them. Pokémon data comes from PokéAPI and card information from TCGdex; Multidex shows it as provided and cannot guarantee that it is complete or current.

Using Multidex

Multidex is free to browse. Use it for personal reference, and don't interfere with its operation or with the services it relies on.

Signing in is optional. Keep your Google account secure, and log out of or delete accounts you no longer want saved on a shared device.

We may change, add or remove features, and Multidex or some of its content may sometimes be unavailable.

Multidex Plus

Multidex Plus is an optional, automatically renewing monthly or annual subscription sold through Google Play. Prices are shown in the app and confirmed by Google Play before you pay. Subscription information explains renewal, restore and cancellation.

Google Play's terms and refund policies apply to purchases. Cancelling stops future renewals, and Plus stays active until the end of the period you have paid for. The features included in Plus are shown in the app.

Liability and questions

Multidex is provided as is, without warranties, to the extent the law allows. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under applicable consumer law.

Questions about these terms: kunal26das@gmail.com.
